Tracheal_Tubule_Chassis.description: A highly segmented, lightweight chitinous frame lacking true lungs. Instead, oxygen is delivered directly to muscle tissue via a network of spiracles and tracheal tubes. This allows for phenomenal stamina but severely limits maximum body size due to oxygen diffusion constraints.

Myrmecoid_Petiole_Core.description: An incredibly tough, three-part body plan where the thorax and abdomen are separated by a highly flexible, constricted node (petiole). Despite its minuscule size, its geometric structure allows it to bear weights exponentially heavier than itself.
